body.objective: Define and prove well-posedness (existence and uniqueness) of the Schwarzschild exterior complex-frequency boundary-value problem for both the Einstein and additional branches, resolving the additional-branch log-tail ambiguity at infinity, or certify the first well-posedness obstruction.
body.stop_condition: Import BH2_GENERAL_L_STRUCTURAL (horizon ingoing structure, l-independent residue spectrum) and BH2C_METRIC_ALL_ORDERS (asymptotic log tails) by exact hashes, and the finite-flux radiation class result when available. State the exterior domain, the horizon (ingoing/regular) condition, and the outer (outgoing/radiation) condition PRECISELY -- in particular give the outgoing condition that resolves the certified additional-branch log tails at infinity. Prove existence and uniqueness of the BVP solution on the declared complex-omega domain for each branch, or certify the first failed hypothesis (ill-defined outgoing condition for the additional sector, nonuniqueness, or a defect index). Distinguish the Einstein-branch BVP (log-free, standard) from the additional-branch BVP (log-tailed). A single solved frequency does not establish well-posedness.
body.current_gate: exterior complex-omega BVP well-posedness, or exact obstruction
body.forbid: no Conflux; no single-frequency solve called well-posedness; no outgoing condition imposed without resolving the log tails; no discrete spectrum claimed before uniqueness; no stability, quasinormal, ringdown, scattering, positivity, particle, or quantum claim
activates: the boundary-well-posedness entry gate of the BH-3 proof-obligation DAG
body.resource_hint: Boundary-well-posedness gate for BH-3 readiness. The horizon side is characterized (ingoing dimension); the open piece is the outer boundary condition for the log-tailed additional branch. Depends on the finite-flux class and analytic continuation.
